program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((bg (mode g 0))
                  (sep-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                      (all? (lambda (c) (!= (at g r c) bg)) (range 0 w)))
                                    (range 0 h)))
                  (sep-color (at g (first sep-rows) 0))
                  (s-rows (filter (lambda (r)
                                    (all? (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) sep-color))
                                          (range 0 w)))
                                  (range 0 h)))
                  (s-cols (filter (lambda (c)
                                    (all? (lambda (r) (= (at g r c) sep-color))
                                          (range 0 h)))
                                  (range 0 w)))
                  (n-row-secs (+ 1 (length s-rows)))
                  (n-col-secs (+ 1 (length s-cols))))
             (build-grid n-row-secs n-col-secs (r c) bg)))))
